inputs.text: This is yet another clear sign that these government institutions pushed to supposedly tackle inequality through handouts and redistribution are doomed to fail under their own weight. South African actress Terry Pheto is now tied to alleged financial misconduct with the National Lotteries Commission over R20.56 million in this SIU probe, with new details laid out in the briefing to the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. These scandals expose how public money gets siphoned off by insiders instead of serving any real purpose, breeding corruption and dependency rather than order or self-reliance. Such progressive schemes ignore personal responsibility and traditional values, eroding the authority that once held communities together. We need to scrap this approach entirely and refocus on family, national strength, and individual accountability instead of propping up these wasteful authorities.
